title: Bombora Review (2026)
intro: Bombora is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — B2B intent-data specialist best known for Company Surge® topic-level buying signals that help sales and marketing teams prioritize in-market accounts — typically layered onto CRM/ABM stacks rather than used as a contact database. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Bombora when third-party intent data is a named buying criterion and you already have (or will buy) contact data and engagement tools separately.
verdict: Choose Bombora when third-party intent data is a named buying criterion and you already have (or will buy) contact data and engagement tools separately. Compare 6sense or Demandbase when you want intent bundled inside a full ABM platform, and ZoomInfo when you need enterprise contact data with intent add-ons. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Bombora is not a contact database — score is intentionally low. Buyers still need ZoomInfo/Apollo/Cognism-class tools for emails and dials.
Intent helps prioritize which accounts to work, but Bombora does not replace list building or people search UX.
Topic-level Company Surge® signals enrich account prioritization — enrichment of buying context, not classic email waterfall fill.
No native sequencer — outreach happens in other tools. Score reflects intent-only posture.
Delivery into CRM/MAP/ABM partners is a first-party distribution model for surge data.
Conceptually clear (topics + surge), but topic governance and partner delivery add moderate ops work.
Intent analytics and surge reporting are the product’s analytical strength for ABM and sales prioritization.
Custom quotes and specialist scope make value opaque; justified when intent is a named buying criterion in an existing stack.

faq.question: Is Bombora a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Bombora is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use Bombora for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.
